title: Gemini on CarPlay: Stop Grabbing Your Phone 🚗
description:
Gemini is now on Apple CarPlay. Google is rolling out Gemini Live to CarPlay worldwide for Gemini users on iPhone: tap the Gemini icon on your car screen and talk hands-free to catch up on unread emails, draft a reply by voice, check your day or find a lunch spot nearby. To set it up, update the Gemini app, allow the microphone, use Gemini Live on your phone once, then connect your iPhone to your car.

Would you talk to AI while you drive? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop for the newest AI tools and tech news every day.

Source: Google, "Talk it through with Gemini, now on Apple CarPlay" (November 11, 2026); FoneArena (November 12, 2026)
